title: Drop Snatch, set 2
notes: Faster drop under the bar than set 1. Lockout stronger overhead. Coach cue: chin up — chin dropping during the catch, compromising the upper-back position.

title: Drop Snatch, set 1
notes: First exposure to the drop snatch. Drop under the bar is slow — needs more aggression into the receiving position. Arm punch / overhead lockout isn't decisive. Foot angle wider than the standard 10-and-2; flagging as a mobility limitation rather than a cueing issue.

title: Jerk, heavy single from rack
notes: Not getting under the bar fast enough or low enough.

title: Jerk, working set from rack
notes: Not fully extended; rushing to get under the bar.

title: Jerk, building set from rack
notes: Dip drifts forward of vertical; bar travels off midfoot. Incomplete drive — not finishing triple extension at the hips. Recurring fault across the session.

title: Press in Split, third set
notes: Midline braced and glutes engaged through the split. Lockout incomplete — elbows not fully extending overhead.

title: Below-the-knee hang power clean + push press, set 4
notes: Setup is solid: flat back, lats engaged, gaze forward. Strong, patient pull — bar makes contact at the mid-thigh before the jump. Fast turnover through the elbows but could be quicker. Push press is OK; needs more leg drive before the arms take over.

title: Below-the-knee hang power clean + push press, set 3
notes: Same as set 4 — flat back, lats engaged, gaze forward; patient pull with mid-thigh contact; fast turnover but could be quicker. Push press has stronger leg drive than set 4 — better drive from the legs before the arms take over.

title: Below-the-knee hang power clean + push press, set 2
notes: Same mix of strong points and faults seen in the other sets. Standout: very consistent setup — flat back and patient pull with mid-thigh contact. Main issue is the push press: leg drive isn't consistent — arms take over before the legs finish.

title: Below-the-knee hang power clean + push press, set 1
notes: Push press leg drive is especially weak on this rep — arms take over before the legs finish. The session's recurring push press fault is most pronounced here.

title: Raised snatch deadlift, set 3
notes: Bar elevated on 20kg plates. Hips and shoulders rise together off the floor — no hips-first fault. Shoulders well-stacked over the bar at the start.

title: Paused Back Squat, set 4
notes: Same as set 3 — depth dialed in, tension maintained through the full ascent, ribs stacked over hips. Clean execution.

title: Paused Back Squat, set 3
notes: Depth dialed in. Tension maintained through the full ascent, ribs stacked over hips. Clean execution — no faults to call out.

title: Paused Back Squat, set 2
notes: Better than set 1 — held brace and tension through the entire ascent (the cue from set 1). Also got deeper, breaking parallel more decisively.

title: Paused Back Squat, set 1
notes: Three-second pause at the bottom. Good breathing — ribs stacked over hips, strong brace. Focus on maintaining that tension all the way through the ascent. Toe angle slightly wider than ideal; flagging as a mobility limitation rather than a cueing issue.
